programs.title: Ghosts Off Grid
programs.desc: The ghost hunters trek to Calgary's historic Inglewood neighborhood and the Alexandra Centre, a sturdy three-story sandstone building with a highly haunted history; they're given a tour and tips by another ghost hunter.

programs.title: Quest for the Lost Vikings
programs.desc: As planning for a northern expedition continues, the Farm Heim team starts testing the gear they will use in their bigger quest. Meanwhile, Jo, Johann, and David set out for Berens River, a place with potential clues of Lost Vikings.

programs.title: Alien Corridors
programs.desc: A look at what it is about this barren land that is attracting alien attention; is it the sensation of otherworldliness making it feel like home?

programs.title: To Kill a Dictator
programs.desc: Although Stalin was paranoid, there's little doubt that many wanted him dead; analyzing if the last plot against Stalin's life was successful; discussing if succumbing to illness at 74 means that his death is less than natural.

programs.title: Revolutions That Changed History
programs.desc: A secret society of Russian military officers with dreams of political revolution set out to overthrow the Romanovs by spreading a lie about one Tsar usurping another.

programs.title: Into the Universe: Mysteries of the Cosmos
programs.desc: Hidden in plain sight are astronomic marvels able to rip space and time to shreds; what's theoretical becomes the reality with the first black hole image, but much remains unknown; how do black holes form and do they create galaxies?
